integrity: The published theorem and proof were inspected in the full article. The counterexample is an exact two-dimensional projection example, and the repair is proved directly in both directions. No numerical experiment or finite search is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The equivalence assumes \(TK^*=K^*T\) and concerns preservation of every \(K\)-\(g\)-frame for the fixed pair \((K,T)\). It does not characterize one particular frame or the noncommuting case, and it requires no closed-range hypothesis on \(K\).
title: Bounded below on \(R(K^*)\) is the exact missing hypothesis in a \(K\)-\(g\)-frame composition theorem
